launcher_environment.ISAAC_ENV_DIR: optional environment root used to prepend lib/
launcher_environment.ISAAC_PYTHON: required absolute path to the Isaac Sim Python executable

optional_system_tools.name: ffmpeg
optional_system_tools.purpose: Post-process existing FPV video or captured observation frames into an MP4; it is not required when video mode is off.

model_api_configuration.endpoint_policy: Remote endpoints require HTTPS; cleartext HTTP is accepted only for loopback self-hosted endpoints.

provider_endpoints.http-json: Role-specific base_url using the provider-neutral /generate contract; loopback defaults are available.
provider_endpoints.openai-compatible: Role-specific base_url for a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint.
provider_endpoints.openai: Hosted OpenAI endpoint, or an explicit compatible base_url.
provider_endpoints.anthropic: Hosted Anthropic Messages endpoint, or an explicit base_url.
provider_endpoints.gemini: Hosted Google Gemini generateContent endpoint, or an explicit base_url.

required_external_assets.name: BEHAVIOR-1K baked USD cache
required_external_assets.reason: The full BEHAVIOR-1K asset corpus is too large and separately licensed.

required_external_assets.name: BEHAVIOR-1K source data
required_external_assets.reason: Scene graphs and source asset metadata are distributed separately.

required_external_assets.name: MANO Python software
required_external_assets.license_policy: No Distribution; each user must obtain it from the licensor.

required_external_assets.name: SMPL+H male body model
required_external_assets.license_policy: No Distribution; each user must obtain it from the licensor.

required_external_assets.name: ACCAD/AMASS forward walk clip
required_external_assets.license_policy: No Distribution; each user must obtain it from the licensor.

required_external_assets.name: Licensed human grasp assets
required_external_assets.license_policy: Not redistributed; install only from an authorized local asset source.

optional_environment.ISAAC_FRAMES_PER_SEG: Number of rendered observations sampled across each semantic action; SimulatorConfig.frames_per_action defaults to 4
optional_environment.ISAAC_RENDER_SELECTED_ONLY: Render only selected observation frames instead of rendering a dense trajectory and discarding frames
optional_environment.ISAAC_VIS_GATE: Restrict actionable object keys to the measured egocentric visible set
optional_environment.INTERACTIVEWORLD_RUN_ROOT: Optional benchmark-run parent directory; defaults to the platform temporary directory/interactiveworld-runs
optional_environment.INTERACTIVEWORLD_OUTPUT_DIR: Low-level TaskPack runner output directory; defaults to /tmp/interactiveworld-output
